review_units.acceptance: A complete circular city silhouette with no empty plateau; the radial navigation structure reads from source-match and top views.
The keep is vertically dominant, industrial-gothic, visibly embedded in the city, and not a generic castle chess piece.
A continuous, human-scale route with at least two elevation changes and two meaningful navigation choices is visible.
The route flows visibly from the keep through the gate, down a banked cascade, and into a basin large enough for the later iron skiff.
